children: Rohit panda moves into the india hr leadership role as vanguard expands its presence in hyderabad

Vanguard has appointed Rohit Panda as Head of HR, India, based in Hyderabad. Panda takes on the role in October 2026 after more than two years as HR Director and Senior Business Partner for Vanguard’s Technology Division, where he also supported the HR strategy and setup for the company’s India operations.

In his new position, Panda will lead the HR function for Vanguard’s India operations. His appointment comes as the global investment management company continues to establish its presence in Hyderabad.

Panda has been involved in Vanguard’s India expansion, including HR strategy and setup for the Hyderabad office. His previous responsibilities also covered HR support for outsourcing and insourcing, divestitures and change initiatives.
Panda brings experience across HR business partnering, consulting, talent acquisition, people transition and change management.
Before joining Vanguard, he spent more than 14 years at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), where he held multiple HR and consulting roles across India and North America.

From April 2017 to August 2024, Panda served as HR Director, Business Consulting, focusing on M&A, Global Capability Centre (GCC) strategy and business deals for TCS North America. His responsibilities included HR due diligence, workforce transition, integration, operating model design and people-related aspects of business transactions.
Earlier at TCS, Panda worked as HR Manager, People Transition for India and North America. He supported people transition and business consulting activities across India, the US and Canada.

He also served as Programme Manager and HR Specialist for Global Talent Acquisition, working on talent management, competency development, internal rotations, succession planning, HR processes and analytics.
Panda began his TCS career as Talent Acquisition Lead for the Bengaluru and Kochi regions, where he worked on recruitment strategy and delivery for business leadership.
Across his career, Panda has worked on HR aspects of M&A, GCC and greenfield setups, Build-Operate-Transfer models and digital transformation programmes.

His professional experience also includes advising organisations on workforce transition, target operating models, employee integration and people processes. He holds an MBA in Human Resources from Alliance University and a certification in Human Resources Management and Services from Columbia Business School.
Panda’s move into the India HR leadership role brings his experience in business partnering, workforce transitions and large-scale organisational change to Vanguard’s growing India operations.
